name: chipi
description: Describe an instruction set once. Generate decoders, disassemblers, and dispatchers in Rust, C++, or Python from a small declarative language.

name: chapa
description: Turn Rust structs into typed bitfields with generated accessors. Supports scattered bits, signed values, nested fields, and enums.

name: ceload
description: A BYOVD research tool for loading Cheat Engine's dbk64.sys driver and accessing its privileged functions.

name: SilentLoad
